verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents white-labeling, rebranding, or embedding the Windmill builder or flow editor inside a third-party product for that product's customers. Self-hosting via Docker or Helm, the custom-frontend app builder, and app guests who sign in through your identity provider are adjacent deployment and access features, not white-label embedding.

support.subject: As a developer, I can embed the automation platform white-label inside my own product for my customers
